bootstrap_go_toolset: run the bootstrap function to install and configure a hermetic Go toolset in the default location
prepare_go_environ: create a dictionary of Go environment variables including GOROOT, GOPATH, and GOBIN for the toolset
install_toolset: download and extract a Go toolset archive from a given URL into a specified root directory
find_executable: find the full path to a Go executable in GOROOT or workspace bin directories
check_hello_world: test the Go toolset by compiling and running a hello world program to verify it works
